ei.title: The Importance of Showing You Care
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: When it comes to helping out, you don't have to do much. All you have to do is come around and show that you care. If you notice someone who is lonely, you could go and sit with them. If you work with someone who eats lunch all by themselves, and you go and sit down with them, they will begin to be more social after a while, and they will owe it all to you. A person's happiness comes from attention. There are too many people out in the world who feel like everyone has forgotten them or ignored them. Even if you say hi to someone passing by, they will begin to feel better about themselves, like someone cares.

questions.passage: When it comes to (A)[harming / helping] out, you don't have to do much. All you have to do is come around and show that you care. If you notice someone who is (B)[lonely / popular], you could go and sit with them. If you work with someone who eats lunch all by themselves, and you go and sit down with them, they will begin to be more (C)[isolated / social] after a while, and they will owe it all to you. A person's happiness comes from attention. There are too many people out in the world who feel like everyone has forgotten them or ignored them. Even if you say hi to someone passing by, they will begin to feel better about themselves, like someone cares.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① helping — lonely — social: 돕는(helping) 것에 관해, 외로운(lonely) 사람과 함께하면, 그 사람이 더 사교적(social)으로 변한다는 맥락에 일치 ←정답
❌ ② harming — lonely — social: (A) harming(해치기)은 '돕기(helping)'와 반대
❌ ③ helping — popular — social: (B) popular(인기 있는)는 '외로운(lonely)' 사람을 돕는 맥락과 다름
❌ ④ helping — lonely — isolated: (C) isolated(고립된)는 더 '사교적(social)'으로 변한다는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: helping out / someone who is lonely / be more social

A person's (B)[happiness / sadness] comes from (C)[neglect / attention]. There are too many people out in the world who feel like everyone has forgotten them or ignored them. Even if you say hi to someone passing by, they will begin to feel better about themselves, like someone cares.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① ignore — happiness — attention: (A) ignore(무시하다)는 '관심을 갖는다(care)'는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② care — sadness — attention: (B) sadness(슬픔)는 관심에서 오는 '행복(happiness)'과 반대
✅ ③ care — happiness — attention: 관심을 갖고(care) 있음을 보여 주며, 사람의 행복(happiness)은 관심(attention)에서 온다는 맥락에 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ care — happiness — neglect: (C) neglect(방치)는 행복이 '관심(attention)'에서 온다는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: show that you care / A person's happiness comes from attention

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① helping out: 'When it comes to __________, you don't have to do much'에서 글 전체가 외로운 사람을 돕는 것을 다루므로 '돕는 것(helping out)'이 적절 ←정답

❌ ② making money(돈을 버는 것): 글의 주제와 무관

❌ ③ winning games(경기에서 이기는 것): 문맥과 무관

❌ ④ staying home(집에 머무는 것): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: When it comes to helping out = 돕는 것에 관해서

questions.passage: When it comes to helping out, you don't have to do much. All you have to do is __________ and show that you care. If you notice someone who is lonely, you could go and sit with them. If you work with someone who eats lunch all by themselves, and you go and sit down with them, they will begin to be more social after a while, and they will owe it all to you. A person's happiness comes from attention. There are too many people out in the world who feel like everyone has forgotten them or ignored them. Even if you say hi to someone passing by, they will begin to feel better about themselves, like someone cares.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① run away(달아나다): 관심을 보여 주는 맥락과 반대

❌ ② stay silent(침묵하다): 다가가 관심을 보이는 맥락과 어긋남

✅ ③ come around: 'All you have to do is __________ and show that you care'에서 관심을 보여 주려면 상대에게 '다가가는(come around)' 것이 필요하다는 맥락 ←정답

❌ ④ give up(포기하다): 문맥과 반대
det.tip: come around and show that you care = 다가가서 관심을 보여 주다
